claude.sample_unit: simulated emergency vignette scenarios (28 vignettes x 2 replicates)

links.outcome: Counterfactual monotonicity violations under Base/Worse vignette pairs by persona
links.effect: LEAN personas violated monotonicity in 10/16 comparisons (62.5%); SAFE personas 0/16; routing reduced violations (ROUTER_R1 2/16; ROUTER_R2 audit 0/16).
links.quote: In counterfactual monotonicity testing, LEAN personas violated monotonicity in 10/16 comparisons (62.5%) whereas SAFE personas had 0/16 violations; routing reduced violations (ROUTER_R1 2/16; ROUTER_R2 (audit) 0/16).

links.outcome: Contraindication/sequence safety violations in LLM emergency clinical reasoning by persona
links.effect: Lean baseline BASE_HL had safety violations in 8/56 scenarios (14.3%; mean severity 0.39); SAFE baselines and routers had zero violations.
links.quote: The lean baseline (BASE_HL) suggested the fewest tests (mean 1.95) but had safety violations in 8/56 scenarios (14.3%; mean severity 0.39).

unlisted_practices: Persona routing (escalating from lean to safe persona using red-flag triggers, dual-run auditing, arbitration) as a prompt-level safety wrapper
Counterfactual monotonicity testing (Base vs Worse vignette pairs) as a stress test

links.effect: Routing eliminated safety violations; monotonicity violations fell from LEAN 10/16 to ROUTER_R1 2/16 and ROUTER_R2 0/16.
links.quote: Routing eliminated safety violations while keeping test counts near the lean baseline (ROUTER_R1 mean 2.14; ROUTER_R2_AUDIT mean 2.20; ROUTER_R3_ARBITER mean 2.21).

links.effect: LEAN personas 10/16 (62.5%); SAFE personas 0/16; ROUTER_R1 2/16; ROUTER_R2 audit 0/16.
links.quote: In counterfactual monotonicity testing, LEAN personas violated monotonicity in 10/16 comparisons (62.5%) whereas SAFE personas had 0/16 violations; routing reduced violations (ROUTER_R1 2/16; ROUTER_R2 (audit) 0/16).

links.effect: BASE_HL had 8/56 safety violations (14.3%; mean severity 0.39); SAFE baselines had zero safety violations.
links.quote: The lean baseline (BASE_HL) suggested the fewest tests (mean 1.95) but had safety violations in 8/56 scenarios (14.3%; mean severity 0.39).

unlisted_practices: Persona routing combining LEAN and SAFE prompts to preserve efficiency while reducing safety failures
